title: Privacy Policy
body:
Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy of Nooney & Dowdall LLP Solicitors

This Privacy Policy outlines the handling of personal data by Nooney & Dowdall LLP Solicitors.

Website: www.mullingarsolicitors.ie.

Data Collection and Use:

We respect the privacy of those who visit our website and those who provide personally identifiable information, our valued customers and members. In accordance with this, please take note of the privacy commitment to our website users.

Information Collection and Use:

We use tracking information to determine which areas our site users visit based on traffic to those areas. Our system logs and records your IP address, dates and times of site visits, the pages visited, type of browser and cookie information. This data is only used to measure the number of visitors to the site, to help us maintain a superior and informative website for you and will not be used to identify you.

Visitors may decide to send an email via the site in which may be included personally identifying information. Such information is only used to enable a suitable response.

Personally identifiable information is collected in the quick contact form. We will use this information to respond to your request and to contact you about our services should this be applicable.

Disclaimer:

NDSOL.ie does not control the privacy policies of any other sites to which we provide hyperlinks or might suggest or recommend in any way. Voluntarily disclosing personal information on sites hyperlinked to or suggested by ndsol.ie is done at your own risk.

Contacting Nooney & Dowdall LLP Solicitors about Privacy:

Maintaining the privacy of your information is of paramount importance to us as it helps foster confidence, goodwill and stronger relationships with you, our customers. If, at any time, you have questions or concerns about our privacy practices, please feel free to contact us.
